answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a opal as the anchor of the cost.
